_note: 2026-11-18 사용자: Codex 세션 영상은 전부 불합격, 화풍만 합격. 합격한 화풍 그림을 참조(ref)로 붙여 같은 그림체로 새 원화를 만든다. plate = 사람 없는 배경, sheet = 흰 배경 위 조각 여러 개(art-cut 으로 자름).

curiosity.text: Match the attached reference images exactly in art style: hand-painted Japanese casual cel animation look, soft painted backgrounds with visible gouache texture, clean thin dark-brown character line art, warm natural light, gentle muted palette.

ai-guide.text: Match the attached reference image exactly in art style: friendly flat vector product illustration, mint and teal palette with warm peach and navy accents, soft grain texture, rounded chunky shapes, subtle soft shadows, no outlines-heavy look.

issues.text: Match the attached reference image exactly in art style: detailed editorial illustration with clean ink linework and flat warm color fills, slight paper grain, Korean news-magazine illustration feel, calm documentary tone.

orders.prompt: Wide establishing background, no people: a Paris street in 1877 at golden late afternoon, Haussmann-style cream stone buildings with iron balconies, a small bookshop and print shop with a stack of journals in the window, gas street lamps, cobblestones, a horse carriage far in the background, warm sky. Leave the lower middle of the street open for a character to stand.

Character model sheet of the SAME man: a 54-year-old French philosopher in 1877, neat grey beard, kind thoughtful eyes, dark frock coat, waistcoat, holding a thin journal. Four full-body poses side by side, all facing slightly right, same scale: (1) walking mid-stride holding the journal at his side; (2) standing and reading the open journal; (3) standing, one hand on his chin, thinking with eyes looking up; (4) standing, raising one finger as if explaining an idea, slight smile.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a thin 19th-century French philosophy journal lying flat, cream paper cover with a simple ornamental border and no readable text; (2) a single torn-off paper calendar page curling slightly, no numbers; (3) a round wall clock with a wooden rim and a cream face with simple tick marks but NO hands; (4) a modern paper wall calendar showing a month grid with no readable text, hanging on a nail.

Background, no people: a cozy small modern Korean apartment room in mid-November at dusk, a desk by the window with a lamp, a mug and books, city lights outside, a bare wall area on the right side where a calendar and a clock will be placed later. Leave the left-center open for a person.

Character model sheet of the SAME young Korean woman in her early thirties, shoulder-length black hair loosely tied, navy knit sweater, jeans. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale: (1) looking up and to the right at a wall, hands by her side; (2) shoulders dropped, eyes half closed, sighing; (3) turning her head back over her shoulder with a puzzled face; (4) reaching up with her right hand as if to lift a calendar page.

Extra wide panoramic background, no people: an endless Korean countryside summer in late July seen from a low hill, a dirt road winding from the foreground far to the distant horizon, a sparkling sea and small beach on the left, rice paddies and tall grass with wildflowers, a rural bus stop sign by the road in the middle distance, towering cumulus clouds, bright nostalgic light.

Character model sheet of the SAME 10-year-old Korean boy in summer: messy short black hair, sun-tanned, white t-shirt, blue shorts, red sneakers, a straw hat. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) running joyfully to the right; (2) standing amazed with mouth open, pointing ahead; (3) holding up one finger with a red dragonfly resting on it, eyes wide with delight; (4) standing with a small backpack, waving goodbye happily.

Background, no people: a plain open-plan Korean office in grey weekday morning light, rows of identical desks and monitors, a window with grey city buildings, fluorescent ceiling lights, a desk in the foreground center with an empty office chair and a monitor, a bare partition wall on the right for a calendar. Slightly desaturated, repetitive, quiet mood.

Character model sheet of the SAME Korean office worker in his late thirties: short black hair, white shirt with a loose grey tie, lanyard ID badge, tired eyes. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) sitting on an office chair typing on a keyboard (chair included); (2) standing, slumped shoulders, holding a coffee cup, tired; (3) standing, looking surprised at something on his right; (4) walking quickly to the right holding a laptop bag.

Wide background, no people: a bright airport boarding gate hall, a check-in counter with a closed retractable belt barrier in front of the boarding door, large windows with a parked airplane outside, departure board with blank panels, potted plants. Leave the floor in the lower middle open for a small character.

Character model sheet of the SAME small friendly AI assistant robot mascot: a rounded cream-white body like a smooth pebble, a dark navy screen face with two simple glowing mint eyes, small rounded arms and short legs, a tiny antenna with a peach light. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) walking happily to the right holding a paper plane ticket; (2) stopped, standing still and drooping, ticket lowered, eyes sad; (3) standing proudly holding a small green wallet up with both hands; (4) sitting and typing busily on a small laptop, little motion sparkles around it.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side, same style: (1) a peach paper airline boarding ticket with a small airplane icon and barcode stripes; (2) a dark green credit card with a gold chip, no numbers; (3) an open dark green leather wallet; (4) a big round navy padlock, closed.

Wide background, no people: a cheerful shopping street with five small shop fronts in a row, awnings in mint, peach and navy; the two shops on the left have open glass doors with warm light inside, the three shops on the right have their roll-down shutters closed. Sidewalk in front, sky above.

Wide background: a calm bedroom-study at night, a person asleep in bed on the left under a blanket (seen from behind, face not visible), a desk on the right with an open laptop glowing mint, a window with a moon and city lights, a wall clock. Leave space on the desk next to the laptop for a small robot.

Sheet of four separate hand illustrations side by side in the same chunky flat style with navy suit cuffs: (1) a hand holding out a green wallet, offering it; (2) a hand holding a smartphone showing a blank glowing screen; (3) an open palm raised in a stop gesture; (4) a handshake between a human hand and a small rounded cream-white robot hand.

Wide background: a central bank press briefing room in Seoul, a wooden podium with microphones on the right, a large blank presentation screen on the wall, rows of reporters seen from behind with laptops and cameras in the foreground, neutral institutional interior, no logos, no text.

Wide background, no people, no kites: a calm sky over the sea at early morning seen from a coastal hill in East Asia, layered islands and a distant harbor city, soft clouds, lots of open sky in the upper two thirds for objects to fly.

Sheet of four separate traditional East Asian dragon kites side by side, each with a long fluttering tail, same size and same craftsmanship but different color schemes: (1) deep blue and white; (2) crimson red and gold; (3) jade green and cream; (4) orange and black. No flags, no symbols, no text.

Wide background, no people: a bank currency exchange counter seen from the customer side, a clean counter top in the foreground with an empty tray, a teller window, a blank exchange rate board on the wall, soft daylight. Leave the counter top empty for objects.

Prop sheet of four separate objects side by side: (1) a neat tall stack of Korean won banknotes in green and yellow tones, no readable text or faces; (2) a neat small stack of US dollar banknotes in green, no readable text or faces; (3) a small pile of coins; (4) a paper bank receipt slip with blank lines, no readable text.

Extra wide panoramic background at dusk, no text: on the left the Seoul skyline with the Han River, bridges, apartment towers and Namsan tower; on the right the Taipei skyline with the tall segmented Taipei 101 tower and mountains behind; the two cities blend in the middle across the sea under one continuous sky with a strong wind sweeping clouds.

Wide background: inside a semiconductor memory chip factory clean room, long rows of wafer processing machines and overhead wafer transport rails, a few workers in white clean-room suits at a distance, yellow lighting, a strong sense of scale and depth.

Prop sheet of four separate objects side by side: (1) a green memory module stick with black chips; (2) a shiny silicon wafer with a grid of dies; (3) a large square AI accelerator chip package with a metal lid; (4) a paper price tag with a string, blank.

Background, no people: a philosopher's study in Paris in 1877 at dusk, a wooden writing desk with manuscripts, an inkwell and a quill, tall bookshelves, a window showing Paris rooftops and chimneys, warm oil lamp light. Leave the right half of the floor open for a standing person.

Background, no people: a warm Korean family dining room in the evening, a long wooden table in the middle with nothing on it, a window with soft light, a few plants. Leave the table top empty and open space at both sides of the table for people.

Extra wide background, no people, no vehicles: a side view of a long straight countryside road running left to right across the frame, rice fields and distant mountains behind, guard rail, telephone poles, clear sky.

Background, no people: William James's study in Cambridge, Massachusetts in 1890, Victorian interior, a desk piled with thick manuscript pages, a green-shaded lamp, bookshelves, a window with snowy trees outside. Leave the left half of the floor open for a standing person.
Background seen from the back of the room: a modern lecture hall, rows of audience members seen from behind, a large blank projection screen at the front, a lectern. No text on the screen.

Background, no people: a German university psychology office in 2005, a desk with a bulky CRT monitor, tall stacks of paper questionnaires and brown envelopes, filing cabinets, a window with a European city. Leave open floor space in the center for two people.

Background, no people: a quiet community hall with a long low table facing the viewer, two empty chairs placed in front of the table facing the viewer, pencils and blank paper on the table, sunlight from tall windows.
Background, no people: a rural Korean bus stop in late morning, a wooden shelter with an empty bench, a bus stop sign, a two-lane road stretching to the right, trees, a quiet sleepy mood.
Background, no people: a dull corporate meeting room, a long table with empty chairs, a projector screen showing nothing, a plain wall clock, grey daylight, very still and boring mood.
Background, no people: a sunny unfamiliar old European town, a winding cobblestone alley with colorful houses, flower pots, a confusing fork in the road, morning light.
Background, no people: a bustling foreign street food market at noon seen from the aisle, colorful stalls with steaming pots and hanging lanterns, empty aisle in the foreground for a person.
Background, no people: a narrow unfamiliar alley at evening with warm lanterns, small shops, a cat on a step, blue dusk sky, empty path in the foreground.
Background, no people: a quiet Korean residential street in late November at dusk, golden ginkgo leaves on the ground, warm windows, a small path leading away into the distance.

Character model sheet of the SAME Korean man aged 50: short greying hair, glasses, beige cardigan over a shirt, slacks. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale: (1) looking down and to the right with mild curiosity; (2) shoulders dropped, sighing; (3) nodding with a small smile, hands together; (4) pointing up with one finger, explaining.

Character model sheet of the SAME 14-year-old Korean middle-school girl in a navy school uniform with a cardigan, short black hair. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) sitting on a simple chair writing on a clipboard on her lap; (2) sitting on a simple chair, pencil on chin, looking up thinking; (3) standing, raising her wrist to check her wristwatch; (4) standing, bored, hands in pockets, looking to the right.

Character model sheet of the SAME 94-year-old Korean grandmother, white hair in a bun, soft lavender cardigan, long skirt, a wooden cane. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) sitting on a simple chair writing on a clipboard on her lap with reading glasses; (2) sitting on a simple chair, looking up thinking, gentle face; (3) standing with her cane, checking a small wristwatch; (4) standing with her cane, smiling warmly.

Character model sheet of the SAME man: the American psychologist William James in 1890, age 48, full brown beard, kind sharp eyes, tweed three-piece suit with a bow tie. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale, all facing slightly left: (1) reading a thick manuscript; (2) hand on chin, thinking; (3) raising one finger, gently making a point; (4) writing in a notebook held in one hand.

Character sheet of TWO German researchers in 2005, same scale, four full-body standing poses side by side: (1) a man in his late thirties with short hair, rimless glasses and a grey sweater, carrying a tall stack of paper questionnaires; (2) a woman in her early thirties with a blonde ponytail and a blue blouse, holding up one questionnaire sheet; (3) the same man reading a printout with surprised raised eyebrows; (4) the same woman pointing at a sheet of paper in her other hand, explaining.

Character model sheet of the SAME young Korean woman as in the attached character reference sheet (shoulder-length black hair loosely tied), now in travel clothes: light denim jacket, white t-shirt, beige trousers, a small backpack, sneakers. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) standing holding an unfolded paper map, confused, scratching her head; (2) standing eating street food from a skewer, delighted; (3) walking to the right, looking around with wonder; (4) sitting cross-legged holding an open photo album, smiling softly.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side, same style: (1) a small round two-layer cream cake with strawberries; (2) a very large tall many-layered cream cake with strawberries (the same cake design, much bigger); (3) one thick triangular slice of that cake lying on its side; (4) one very thin slice of that same cake, paper-thin, standing upright.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a long old wooden measuring ruler with simple tick marks and no numbers; (2) a single paper questionnaire sheet with blank lines and empty checkboxes, no readable text; (3) a brown paper envelope; (4) an empty open cardboard box, dented and caving in.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a horizontal paper strip with one straight ink line whose two ends have outward-pointing fins like >-----<; (2) a horizontal paper strip of the same length with a straight ink line ending in arrowheads at both ends like <----->; (3) a polaroid photo of a boy running on a summer beach; (4) a polaroid photo of a red dragonfly on a child's fingertip in rice fields.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a polaroid photo of a boy waving from a rural bus window; (2) a polaroid photo of a plain grey office desk with a monitor; (3) an open empty photo album lying flat with cream pages; (4) a polaroid photo of a colorful cobblestone alley in a foreign town.

Prop sheet, two separate vehicles side by side, both seen exactly from the side facing right: (1) a young man in his twenties riding an old bicycle leisurely; (2) a small old-fashioned car driven fast by a man in his sixties with grey hair.

Wide background, no people: a friendly card company token workshop, a mint-colored room with a big machine that has an input slot on the left and an output tray on the right, conveyor belt, small lights and pipes. Leave space in front of the machine.
Wide background, no people: a cheerful hotel front desk, a counter with a small key card tray, room key cabinet behind, potted plants, warm lobby light.
Wide background, no people: a pathway leading to an entrance with four small turnstile gates in a row, each gate with a little blank sign post, velvet ropes.
Wide background, no people: a single shop front seen from outside on the sidewalk, a big glass display window with shelves of products, the cash counter visible inside, the door closed.
Wide background, no people: a shop with its door wide open, a welcome mat, warm light inside, shelves of products, sidewalk in front.
Wide background, no people: a large bright shopping mall atrium with dozens of small storefronts on several floors, each with a dark doorway. Symmetrical, lots of doors.
Wide background, no people: an apartment front door at night, a doorstep with space for a parcel, a small lamp, a mailbox on the wall.
Wide background, no people: a tidy room with a wall of small safe-deposit lockers, one locker door slightly open with a soft glow, a counter in front.
Wide background, no people: a small startup team office with a big table, several monitors, sticky notes on a glass wall, plants; daytime.
Wide background, no people: a classical courthouse exterior with columns and stairs, a clear sky.
Wide background, no people: a modern bank and brokerage building entrance with glass doors closed, a security turnstile inside visible.

Wide background, no people: a crossroads in a small town with a wooden signpost in the middle holding three blank arrow signs pointing to three different paths: one to a shop, one to a tall tech office tower, one to a home.
Wide background, no people: an airport concourse with three boarding gates side by side; the left two gates have open doors with green lights, the right gate has a closed barrier with a red light.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a shiny mint payment token card with a sparkle and a small clock icon, no numbers; (2) a hotel room key card, peach with a wave pattern; (3) a brass house key on a ring; (4) a smartphone showing a large glowing fingerprint on its screen.
Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a shopping cart full of products; (2) a cardboard parcel box with tape; (3) a white envelope with a red seal; (4) a round alarm clock ringing.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a round permission badge showing an eye symbol; (2) a round permission badge showing a shopping cart symbol; (3) a navy safety shield with a check mark; (4) a generic sign-in button card with a simple key symbol, no brand, no text.

Prop sheet, four big rounded jigsaw puzzle pieces side by side: (1) mint piece with a wallet symbol; (2) peach piece with a speech bubble symbol; (3) navy piece with a moon-and-clock symbol; (4) a dashed outline of an empty piece with a question mark, the same shape.

Character model sheet of the SAME friendly shop owner, a middle-aged woman with a mint apron and rolled sleeves. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale: (1) arms open in welcome; (2) arms crossed refusing, frowning; (3) reaching out a hand to shake; (4) hand on chin, thinking.

Character model sheet of the SAME young customer, a man in his twenties with a peach hoodie. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale: (1) looking at his smartphone; (2) pressing his thumb on the phone to approve, satisfied; (3) relaxed, hands behind his head; (4) worried, hand on cheek, looking at his phone.
Wide background: a huge semiconductor foundry campus in Hsinchu, Taiwan, modern fab buildings, cooling towers, palm trees, clean roads, a few workers walking, morning light, no logos.
Wide background: a server assembly factory line, workers in blue uniforms assembling AI server racks on long conveyor lines, bright, orderly, sense of volume.

Wide background, no people: a traditional Korean outdoor market lane, an empty rice stall with open sacks of rice and a blank price board, awnings, morning light. Leave the stall front open for a farmer.
Wide background, no people: the back door of a busy large restaurant kitchen, a loading area with stacked rice sacks, a delivery dolly, warm kitchen light inside, steam.
Wide background: the Kaohsiung container port in Taiwan, huge container ships, cranes loading containers, sunny day, sense of record exports.
Wide background: a classic stone central bank headquarters building in Seoul with a domed roof, plaza in front, autumn trees, no text.
Wide background: a Taipei street with shining new glass tech office towers rising behind on the right, and an old row of small shops in the foreground left with half-closed shutters, scooters parked.
Wide background: a factory gate in Taiwan at shift change in the evening, many workers in uniforms walking out through the gate toward food stalls, lights on.
Wide background: a Korean neighborhood street at evening, small restaurants and shops with warm light, a few people walking, factory and office buildings visible in the distance.

Wide background: a clean technical illustration of a semiconductor package on a board seen in a 3/4 isometric view: a large AI processor chip in the center and several empty square pads beside it where memory stacks will go, soft studio lighting, no text.
Wide background: a large Korean memory chip factory complex at dusk, fab buildings with lit windows, a highway, no logos, no text.
Wide background, no people: a road fork on a hill at golden hour, two paths going in different directions with two blank wooden signposts, wide sky.
Wide background, no people: a Korean apartment living room at night, a TV on the wall with a blank glowing screen, a sofa, a coffee table.

Wide background: a long factory wall at evening seen from the neighborhood side, warm light spilling over the top of the wall from the factory, the darker quiet residential street outside, a few shops with dim lights.

Character sheet, same scale, four full-body standing poses side by side: (1) a Korean farmer in his fifties with a straw hat and work vest, calling out to sell rice with one hand raised; (2) the same farmer reaching out to shake hands, holding a contract paper; (3) the same farmer pushing a hand cart loaded with rice sacks; (4) a restaurant chef in white uniform with folded arms, smiling.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) an old brass balance scale with two empty pans, level; (2) a full rice sack; (3) a thick stack of contract papers bound with a clip and a red seal stamp, no readable text; (4) a large magnifying glass.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a single HBM memory stack: eight thin silicon dies stacked like a tiny tower on a base, visible layers; (2) a shipping container; (3) a black AI server rack; (4) a small sack of coins.

Sheet of four small separate standing people figures side by side, all the same height, front view: (1) a factory worker in a bright blue uniform and white helmet; (2) an ordinary person in a grey coat; (3) an ordinary person in a brown jacket; (4) an ordinary person in a dark green sweater.

Character sheet, same scale, four full-body standing poses side by side: (1) a Korean office worker woman in her thirties looking at her salary on her phone, puzzled; (2) a Korean neighborhood restaurant owner in an apron, waiting at the counter; (3) a Taiwanese tech factory worker in a clean-room suit with the hood down, smiling; (4) an analyst in a suit holding a report, explaining.
